params.name: user_guid
params.description: The unique identifier for a `user`, beginning with the prefix `USR-`.

params.name: from_date
params.description: Filter transactions from this date. This only supports ISO 8601 format without timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 120 days ago if not provided.

params.name: to_date
params.description: Filter transactions to this date (at midnight). This only supports ISO 8601 format without timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 5 days forward from the day the request is made to capture pending transactions.

params.name: page
params.description: Results are paginated. Specify current page.

params.name: records_per_page
params.description: This specifies the number of records to be returned on each page. Defaults to `25`. The valid range is from `10` to `1000`. If the value exceeds `1000`, the default value of `25` will be used instead.

items.docs: All notifications created through the API will be of notification type `API_NOTIFICATION`, channel `PUSH`, and will not be associated to an entity.  No other channels are supported.  This will only have an effect for clients using an MX mobile application.
